description: Make test data — CSV, JSON, SQL, any text — from a .tdc config, instead of writing a generator script. Without `output`: renders in memory and returns the first `preview` lines (max 50) — nothing is written. With `output`: writes the whole file inside the project folder and returns its size, a per-column summary and the first lines. A failed <assert> comes back as row, message, condition and values, so the config can be fixed. Same config and seed give the same bytes every time.

config.description: The .tdc config text. Give this or `path`.

count.description: Override <env count> for this run. For the delivered file keep count in the config instead.

output.description: File to write, relative to the project folder. Omit to preview only.

path.description: A .tdc file, relative to the project folder. Give this or `config`.

seed.description: Override <env seed> for this run. For the delivered file keep seed in the config instead.

name: tdc_generate
title: Generate data from a TDCv2 config
